mapper.insert: insert into payment ( payment_no, student_no, payment_month, payment_amount, payment_status ) values ( #{paymentNo}, #{studentNo}, #{paymentMonth}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentStatus} )
insert into payment_detail ( payment_detail_no, payment_no, course_no, course_fee ) values ( payment_detail_seq.nextval, #{paymentNo}, #{courseNo}, #{courseFee})
insert into payment_discount ( payment_discount_no, payment_no, discount_name, discount_value ) values ( payment_discount_seq.nextval, #{paymentNo}, #{discountName}, #{discountValue})
mapper.select:
select student_no from student
where student_academic_status = '재원'

select c.course_no as courseNo, c.course_fee as courseFee from student_course sc join course c on sc.course_no = c.course_no where sc.student_no = #{studentNo}
and sc.student_course_status in ('신청', '수강중')
mapper.insert: insert into payment_history ( payment_history_no, payment_no, payment_history_amount, payment_history_at ) values ( payment_history_seq.nextval, #{paymentNo}, #{paymentHistoryAmount}, sysdate )
